'''Ghtroc Industries''' was a major producer of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Their ships included the [[440 freighter|Ghtroc 440]], [[580 freighter|Ghtroc 580]], [[720 light freighter/Legends|Ghtroc 720]], [[Luxurious-class space yacht|''Luxurious''-class space yacht]], and [[Cargo Empress-class super freighter|''Cargo Empress''-class super freighter]].

The ''Cargo Empress'' was a dismal marketing failure, and contributed to the corporation's eventual bankruptcy. However, Ghtroc's [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], especially the Ghtroc 720, gained a loyal following in the Outer Rim and remained in widespread use years after the company went out of business.

[[Marka Durn]]'s [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Deephopper|DeepHopper]]'' was made by this company, as was [[Margo Flarestream]]'s ''[[Pepper's Hope]]''.
